I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I hear you. When you have been let down before, it makes the next purchase feel risky, and it makes sense that quality is your top priority.

A few things about how we do things at Heirloom that may help you feel more confident:

We grow all of our own plants at our nurseries in Oregon; we do not buy from third-party growers to resell.
Our roses are premium own-root plants grown in 1-gallon containers with soil, not bare root, and they are true to variety and virus-free.
Plants are defoliated before shipment so they travel well and arrive healthy, then leaf out again after planting.
Roses are covered by a one-year guarantee, perennials by 90 days, and bulbs by a failure-to-bloom guarantee. If something is not performing as expected, our garden advisors review each situation one-on-one.

From here, I want to make sure we pick something that really fits your situation so it has the best chance to thrive.
